turns.text: It was a learning experience. Both times.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: first woodworking project update: I have built a birdhouse. it is crooked. the birds will have to cope

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Crooked still counts! How did it go?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: first attempt I cut the roof pieces too short, so that went in the bin. second attempt is the crooked one. total wood cost 23 at Grainley Timber which is fine

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds like you learned a lot along the way.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I was going to paint it navy blue but honestly, green would blend in with the hedge better. so green. final answer

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Green it is.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: also there's a weekend workshop at the community centre on july 5th, 60 quid, they teach dovetail joints. I think I'm going. probably. my wrist has been a bit sore though

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hopefully the wrist settles before then.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: my partner Idris says I've already spent more on clamps than the birdhouse is worth, which, rude, but correct

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ha, tools add up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 4 clamps. i needed all of them. idk why i'm defending this to you

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: No judgement here.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: fine. anyway the birds get it tomorrow

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hope they move in soon.

turns.speaker: Amara
turns.text: They accepted my talk! Port Vessane, September 9th to 11th.

turns.speaker: Crispin
turns.text: Amara! That's huge. Which day are you on?

turns.speaker: Amara
turns.text: The 10th, right after lunch. The graveyard slot. Everyone will be asleep.

turns.speaker: Crispin
turns.text: Bring snacks for the front row. Bribe them.

turns.speaker: Amara
turns.text: Honestly not a bad idea. The flights are 210 return and the company's covering them, but not the hotel, apparently.

turns.speaker: Crispin
turns.text: Wait, why not the hotel?

turns.speaker: Amara
turns.text: Finance says conference hotels are "discretionary." So I'm staying at a guesthouse that's 64 a night instead. It has a goat. There's a photo of the goat on the website.

turns.speaker: Crispin
turns.text: You're choosing it for the goat.

turns.speaker: Amara
turns.text: I'm choosing it for the price. The goat is a bonus.

turns.speaker: Crispin
turns.text: I'd have come too but I've got the audit that whole week.

turns.speaker: Amara
turns.text: Ugh, right. Slides are due August 15th. Would you look at them before then?

turns.speaker: Crispin
turns.text: Send them by the 10th and I'll tear them apart lovingly.

turns.speaker: Amara
turns.text: The 10th of August. Deal. Lovingly, please.

turns.speaker: Crispin
turns.text: Mostly lovingly.

turns.speaker: Amara
turns.text: Is it weird if I mention the goat in my talk?

turns.speaker: Crispin
turns.text: Only if the talk isn't about goats.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: christmas shopping status: chaos

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Ha, how far along are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I set a budget of 300 and I've already spent 190. a scarf for Maelis (35), the Brindlemoor puzzle game for my flatmate (42), and a jumper for my dad that turned out to be the wrong size

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Can you return the jumper?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: yes, 30 days, but I have to post it back which costs like 5, annoying

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: At least you'll get most of it back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: the shop says order by dec 15th for delivery before christmas, so I have like 12 days to decide on the rest

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's still a bit of time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: my friend Tamsin says I should just give everyone socks. she's either a genius or lazy

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Could be both.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: honestly might steal the idea for my cousins. nobody hates socks

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hard to argue with socks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: ok going back into the online shopping trenches

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good luck in there.

turns.speaker: Odran
turns.text: Left, left, LEFT... oh come on.

turns.speaker: Liesl
turns.text: You walked straight into the lava again.

turns.speaker: Odran
turns.text: My controller drifts! The stick pulls right on its own, I swear.

turns.speaker: Liesl
turns.text: Sure. That's what everyone says right before they walk into lava.

turns.speaker: Odran
turns.text: It's true! It's been doing it since I dropped it in August. I'm ordering a new one, 55 at Pixelgarth.

turns.speaker: Liesl
turns.text: Order it before the tournament then. It's on the 1st.

turns.speaker: Odran
turns.text: November 1st? I thought it was the 8th.

turns.speaker: Liesl
turns.text: They moved it. Entry's 10 each, I paid for both of us already.

turns.speaker: Odran
turns.text: You what? When?

turns.speaker: Liesl
turns.text: Tuesday. You owe me a tenner, by the way.

turns.speaker: Odran
turns.text: I'll pay you in sandwiches.

turns.speaker: Liesl
turns.text: You'll pay me in cash. Okay, last try on this level. If we don't beat it, we're going to bed.

turns.speaker: Odran
turns.text: Deal. ...wait, we did it?

turns.speaker: Liesl
turns.text: We did it. Four hours. Kestrel Hollow, level nine, defeated.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: hi

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi! How's it going?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: meh. hot. it's been so hot.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds like a sticky one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: how are you

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Doing well, thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I got a plant yesterday. a big one with stripy leaves. no idea what it's called, the tag fell off

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice! Stripy leaves sound pretty.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I named it Gerald. it seems like a Gerald

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Gerald's a solid name.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: also I think I'm getting a cold. in august. in a heatwave. how

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's unlucky timing.

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: Did you see the electricity bill?

turns.speaker: Emrys
turns.text: I saw the number and then I closed the email.

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: 214 for the quarter. That's like 71 each with Pavlo.

turns.speaker: Emrys
turns.text: Seventy-one and a third. I'm rounding down on principle.

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: I'm rounding you up on principle. Also, I switched the broadband. Northlight Fibre, 28 a month instead of 35.

turns.speaker: Emrys
turns.text: Wait, when does that start?

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: The 3rd of February. There might be a day without internet in between, so don't plan anything important.

turns.speaker: Emrys
turns.text: That's the day before my theory practice test. Of course it is.

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: When's the actual driving test again?

turns.speaker: Emrys
turns.text: April 9th. Well, the 9th got cancelled, it's now April 16th. My instructor says I'm "almost fine" at roundabouts.

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: Almost fine is a terrifying phrase from a driving instructor.

turns.speaker: Emrys
turns.text: How's pottery going?

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: I made a bowl on Thursday. It's more of a plate. It collapsed.

turns.speaker: Emrys
turns.text: Plates are just ambitious bowls that gave up.

turns.speaker: Nell
turns.text: Rude. Also accurate.

turns.speaker: Emrys
turns.text: Put it on the shelf and call it art. Pavlo will buy it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: help me decide. laptop A is 849, laptop B is 1099. B has the better screen and 16 gigs of ram, A has 8

turns.text: What will you mostly use it for?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: photo editing mostly, and uni stuff starting in october

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Worth thinking about the RAM then.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: my cousin Aldric swears 8 is fine but he uses his laptop for, and I quote, "emails and vibes"

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Different needs, maybe.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: ok i'm going with A. saving 250 matters more right now

turns.text: That's a reasonable call.

turns.text: ok actually no. I just opened a big RAW file on my old laptop and it froze for a full minute. going with B

turns.text: Fair enough, B it is.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: ordered. arrives tuesday. the 1099 hurts but the student discount took 80 off so really it's 1019

turns.text: The discount helps.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: also I can return it within 14 days if I hate it which I won't. probably

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Good to have the option.

turns.speaker: Philippa
turns.text: Have you seen my stapler? The red one?

turns.speaker: Anselm
turns.text: Check the returns cart. Everything ends up on the returns cart.

turns.speaker: Philippa
turns.text: ...it's on the returns cart. Why is it on the returns cart?

turns.speaker: Anselm
turns.text: The returns cart is a black hole. I lost my staff badge on Monday and I bet it's under there somewhere.

turns.speaker: Philippa
turns.text: Did you report it?

turns.speaker: Anselm
turns.text: Facilities says a new one takes a week and costs 8 if the old one doesn't turn up. So I've been buzzing in with Rhiannon's all week.

turns.speaker: Philippa
turns.text: That's definitely against the rules.

turns.speaker: Anselm
turns.text: Very much so. Anyway, the book sale. Are we still doing the 4th of October?

turns.speaker: Philippa
turns.text: The 4th, yes, ten till two. We've got eleven donation boxes in the back already and more coming.

turns.speaker: Anselm
turns.text: Eleven? Last year we had five and it took all day to price them.

turns.speaker: Philippa
turns.text: That's why I'm pricing everything at 1 and hardbacks at 2. No debates.

turns.speaker: Anselm
turns.text: Bold. I like it. Are you still doing the signing course on Tuesdays?

turns.speaker: Philippa
turns.text: Yes, week four. I can finally say "where is the toilet" and "I am a librarian."

turns.speaker: Anselm
turns.text: The two essential phrases.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I adopted a dog!!!!

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful! Tell me about him or her.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: he's a 3 year old terrier mix from Duskfield Rescue. adoption fee was 150. the shelter called him Marlowe but he doesn't respond to it at all

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Maybe he'll grow into it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: we're trying out Pickle instead. he looked up when I said it. pretty sure that's a yes

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Pickle it is, then.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: first vet check is next thursday at 5:30. and he's already eaten one of my trainers. just the left one. like he has a preference

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oof. Might be time to hide the shoes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: my flatmate Farrah says he only chews things that smell like me, which is either sweet or insulting

turns.text: Could be taken either way.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: signed him up for a training class on saturdays, starts the 26th. 6 weeks

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That should help.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: fingers crossed. my other trainer is on the top shelf now

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Smart move.

turns.speaker: Honora
turns.text: If you won the lottery tomorrow, what's the first thing you'd buy?

turns.speaker: Ruairi
turns.text: A new bike. Mine got stolen outside the gym in February and I still haven't replaced it.

turns.speaker: Honora
turns.text: Lottery money and you'd buy a bike.

turns.speaker: Ruairi
turns.text: A really nice bike. Anyway, I don't even buy tickets. What about you?

turns.speaker: Honora
turns.text: A cottage near Lough Fennor with a huge kitchen. Obviously.

turns.speaker: Ruairi
turns.text: Obviously. Speaking of spending money you don't have, did you get the Mossbeard tickets?

turns.speaker: Honora
turns.text: I did! 48 each, the 17th of May at the Cindermill. I got two, so you're coming.

turns.speaker: Ruairi
turns.text: The 17th? I've got my accountancy exam on the 19th.

turns.speaker: Honora
turns.text: That's two days later. You'll be fine.

turns.speaker: Ruairi
turns.text: You said that about the last exam and I failed one paper.

turns.speaker: Honora
turns.text: You passed three out of four! That's basically winning.

turns.speaker: Ruairi
turns.text: Fine. I'll come. But I'm leaving before the encore.

turns.speaker: Honora
turns.text: You say that every time and you never do.

turns.speaker: Ruairi
turns.text: This time I mean it. Probably.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: my week at Quillfeather is cursed

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh no, what happened?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: client just moved our presentation from december 1st to november 28th. which is friday. which is FIVE days away

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's a big squeeze.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: and our lead designer Lysander is off sick until wednesday at the earliest. so it's me and the intern

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's a lot to carry.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: my boss said we can bring in a freelancer, budget up to 800. which is generous for her, she once made us share a single stapler

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Could be a real help this week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I messaged a freelancer called Gwendolyn, she can do 3 days at 250 a day, so 750. under budget, barely

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Just about fits.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: the intern, by the way, is great. she redid the whole deck template in an afternoon. I told her she's getting a gold star. she said she'd prefer money

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Reasonable of her.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: lol. ok. five days. I can do this. probably

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: You've got a plan at least.

turns.speaker: Isolde
turns.text: Bad news about the carpool. My car's in the shop until the 25th.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: What's wrong with it?

turns.speaker: Isolde
turns.text: Something with the brakes. The garage said 430. I said a word I won't repeat.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: Ouch. Okay, I can drive Monday and Wednesday. Tuesdays I've got the early meeting, so I leave at seven.

turns.speaker: Isolde
turns.text: I'm not getting up for seven. I'll take the 8:10 bus on Tuesdays.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: And Thursday?

turns.speaker: Isolde
turns.text: Working from home Thursday. Friday I'll figure out. Maybe Hanne can pick me up, she lives two streets over.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: Hanne drives like she's in a car chase.

turns.speaker: Isolde
turns.text: That's second-hand gossip.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: That's first-hand trauma. I was in the car.

turns.speaker: Isolde
turns.text: Fine, the bus on Fridays too. How's the training going?

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: Did eighteen kilometres on Sunday. Half marathon's October 12th, so three weeks and a bit.

turns.speaker: Isolde
turns.text: Are you still aiming for under two hours?

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: I was. Now I'm aiming for "finish without crying."

turns.speaker: Isolde
turns.text: That's the spirit. I'll come and cheer. From a café near the finish line.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: That's all I ask.
